Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

Got it, happy to clarify! Yes, we do ship internationally to many countries. Duties and taxes work like this:

• In most countries, duties and taxes are included in the product price, and shipping is added at checkout. • In the Philippines, duties, taxes, and shipping are all calculated separately at checkout.

If you tell me what country you are in, I can share what to expect more specifically.
